whenToUse: The title, filters, and search are needed all the time on a long list.
You keep telling people which screen they're on.
The header is short, a single line.
whenNotToUse: The header is tall and covers much of the screen (hide it depending on scroll direction).
Long reading-focused texts (use the screen fully).
